briefdescription.para: Basic block boundary.

detaileddescription.para: Used for live ranges entering and leaving a block without being live in the layout neighbor. Also used as the def slot of PHI-defs.

briefdescription.para: Early-clobber register use/def slot.

detaileddescription.para: A live range defined at Slot_EarlyClobber interferes with normal live ranges killed at Slot_Register. Also used as the kill slot for live ranges tied to an early-clobber def.

briefdescription.para: Normal register use/def slot.

detaileddescription.para: Normal instructions kill and define register live ranges at this slot.

briefdescription.para: Dead def kill point.

detaileddescription.para: Kill slot for a live range that is defined by the same instruction (Slot_Register or Slot_EarlyClobber), but isn't used anywhere.

briefdescription.para: The default distance between instructions as returned by distance().

detaileddescription.para: This may vary as instructions are inserted and removed.

briefdescription.para: Returns the slot for this SlotIndex.
Construct an invalid index.
Returns true if this is a valid index.

detaileddescription.para: Invalid indices do not point into an index table, and cannot be compared.

briefdescription.para: Return true for a valid index.
Print this index to the given raw_ostream.
Dump this index to stderr.
Compare two SlotIndex objects for equality.
Compare two SlotIndex objects for inequality.
Compare two SlotIndex objects.

detaileddescription.para: Return true if the first index is strictly lower than the second.

briefdescription.para: Compare two SlotIndex objects.

detaileddescription.para: Return true if the first index is lower than, or equal to, the second.

briefdescription.para: Compare two SlotIndex objects.

detaileddescription.para: Return true if the first index is greater than the second.

briefdescription.para: Compare two SlotIndex objects.

detaileddescription.para: Return true if the first index is greater than, or equal to, the second.

briefdescription.para: Return the distance from this index to the given one.
Return the scaled distance from this index to the given one, where all slots on the same instruction have zero distance, assuming that the slot indices are packed as densely as possible.

detaileddescription.para: There are normally gaps between instructions, so this assumption often doesn't hold. This results in this function often returning a value greater than the actual instruction distance.

briefdescription.para: isBlock - Returns true if this is a block boundary slot.
isEarlyClobber - Returns true if this is an early-clobber slot.
isRegister - Returns true if this is a normal register use/def slot.

detaileddescription.para: Note that early-clobber slots may also be used for uses and defs.

briefdescription.para: isDead - Returns true if this is a dead def kill slot.
Returns the base index for associated with this index.

detaileddescription.para: The base index is the one associated with the Slot_Block slot for the instruction pointed to by this index.

briefdescription.para: Returns the boundary index for associated with this index.

detaileddescription.para: The boundary index is the one associated with the Slot_Block slot for the instruction pointed to by this index.

briefdescription.para: Returns the register use/def slot in the current instruction for a normal or early-clobber def.
Returns the dead def kill slot for the current instruction.
Returns the next slot in the index list.

detaileddescription.para: This could be either the next slot for the instruction pointed to by this index or, if this index is a STORE, the first slot for the next instruction. WARNING: This method is considerably more expensive than the methods that return specific slots (getUseIndex(), etc). If you can - please use one of those methods.

briefdescription.para: Returns the next index.

detaileddescription.para: This is the index corresponding to the this index's slot, but for the next instruction.

briefdescription.para: Returns the previous slot in the index list.

detaileddescription.para: This could be either the previous slot for the instruction pointed to by this index or, if this index is a Slot_Block, the last slot for the previous instruction. WARNING: This method is considerably more expensive than the methods that return specific slots (getUseIndex(), etc). If you can - please use one of those methods.

briefdescription.para: Returns the previous index.

detaileddescription.para: This is the index corresponding to this index's slot, but for the previous instruction.

briefdescription.para: isSameInstr - Return true if A and B refer to the same instruction.
isEarlierInstr - Return true if A refers to an instruction earlier than B.

detaileddescription.para: This is equivalent to A < B && !isSameInstr(A, B).

briefdescription.para: Return true if A refers to the same instruction as B or an earlier one.

detaileddescription.para: This is equivalent to !isEarlierInstr(B, A).

briefdescription.para: SlotIndex - An opaque wrapper around machine indexes.
